TIFA_CHI.title: Chi Level (%CHI%/%MAXCHI%)
TIFA_CHI.description:
Gain 1 [gold]Chi[/gold] every 5 [gold]Combo[/gold]. Gain cumulative buffs based on your current [gold]Chi[/gold] level. 

1: Gain 1 [gold]Combo[/gold] from using attack cards.
2: Gain 2 [gold]Limit[/gold] at the start of your turn.
3: Gain 1 Strength.
4: Gain 1 Dexterity. 
5: Draw 1 additional card at the start of your turn.
6: Gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
7: Gain 1 additional Energy each turn.
8: Gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity. 
9+: Gain 1 Strength and Dexterity per level.
TIFA_LIMIT.title: Limit Break
TIFA_LIMIT.description:
At 100 [gold]Limit[/gold], Tifa can perform [gold]Limit Break[/gold]. 
Unlock more [gold]Limit[/gold] by increasing your [gold]Chi[/gold] level. 

Gain 5 Limit at the start of each turn. 
Gain 3 Limit per attack hit. 

Any remaining Combo at the end of combat is converted into Limit.
TIFA_COMBO.title: Combo Counter
TIFA_COMBO.description:
Gain Combo from Attacks. Every 5 Combo, increases your [gold]Chi[/gold] Level by 1. Lose 1 [gold]Combo[/gold] every time you take unblocked damage. 

[gold]Limit Breaks[/gold] do not increase [gold]Combo[/gold]. 
If Combo is not increased during your turn, [gold]20%[/gold] of it decays at the end of the turn. 

Remaining Combo at the end of combat is converted into [gold]Limit[/gold].
